+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from app.services import users
+
+_MAX_FORMULA_LENGTH = 60
+
+_DIGITS = frozenset("0123456789")
+_LETTERS = frozenset("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ")
+_WHITESPACE = frozenset(" \t\n\r\f\v")
+_VARIABLES = frozenset(("id", "n"))
+
+
+class _InvalidFormula(Exception):
+    """Raised when a scoring formula is not of the supported form."""
+
+
+def _tokenize(formula: str) -> list[tuple[str, object]]:
+    """Split a formula into number, variable and operator tokens."""
+    tokens: list[tuple[str, object]] = []
+    index = 0
+    length = len(formula)
+    while index < length:
+        char = formula[index]
+        if char in _WHITESPACE:
+            index += 1
+        elif char in _DIGITS:
+            start = index
+            while index < length and formula[index] in _DIGITS:
+                index += 1
+            tokens.append(("number", int(formula[start:index])))
+        elif char in _LETTERS:
+            start = index
+            while index < length and formula[index] in _LETTERS:
+                index += 1
+            word = formula[start:index]
+            if word not in _VARIABLES:
+                raise _InvalidFormula(f"unknown identifier: {word}")
+            tokens.append(("variable", word))
+        elif char == "/":
+            if index + 1 >= length or formula[index + 1] != "/":
+                raise _InvalidFormula("unexpected character: /")
+            tokens.append(("operator", "//"))
+            index += 2
+        elif char in "+-*()":
+            tokens.append(("operator", char))
+            index += 1
+        else:
+            raise _InvalidFormula(f"unexpected character: {char}")
+    return tokens
+
+
+def _parse(formula: str) -> tuple:
+    """Parse a formula into an expression tree, raising _InvalidFormula on error."""
+    tokens = _tokenize(formula)
+    position = 0
+
+    def peek():
+        return tokens[position] if position < len(tokens) else None
+
+    def parse_expression():
+        nonlocal position
+        node = parse_term()
+        while True:
+            token = peek()
+            if token is None or token[0] != "operator" or token[1] not in ("+", "-"):
+                return node
+            position += 1
+            node = ("binary", token[1], node, parse_term())
+
+    def parse_term():
+        nonlocal position
+        node = parse_factor()
+        while True:
+            token = peek()
+            if token is None or token[0] != "operator" or token[1] not in ("*", "//"):
+                return node
+            position += 1
+            node = ("binary", token[1], node, parse_factor())
+
+    def parse_factor():
+        nonlocal position
+        token = peek()
+        if token is not None and token[0] == "operator" and token[1] == "-":
+            position += 1
+            return ("negate", parse_factor())
+        return parse_atom()
+
+    def parse_atom():
+        nonlocal position
+        token = peek()
+        if token is None:
+            raise _InvalidFormula("unexpected end of formula")
+        kind, value = token
+        if kind == "number":
+            position += 1
+            return ("number", value)
+        if kind == "variable":
+            position += 1
+            return ("variable", value)
+        if kind == "operator" and value == "(":
+            position += 1
+            node = parse_expression()
+            if peek() != ("operator", ")"):
+                raise _InvalidFormula("missing closing parenthesis")
+            position += 1
+            return node
+        raise _InvalidFormula(f"unexpected token: {value}")
+
+    node = parse_expression()
+    if position != len(tokens):
+        raise _InvalidFormula("trailing tokens")
+    return node
+
+
+def _evaluate(node: tuple, user_id: int, name_length: int) -> int:
+    """Evaluate a parsed formula for a single user."""
+    kind = node[0]
+    if kind == "number":
+        return node[1]
+    if kind == "variable":
+        return user_id if node[1] == "id" else name_length
+    if kind == "negate":
+        return -_evaluate(node[1], user_id, name_length)
+    operator = node[1]
+    left = _evaluate(node[2], user_id, name_length)
+    right = _evaluate(node[3], user_id, name_length)
+    if operator == "+":
+        return left + right
+    if operator == "-":
+        return left - right
+    if operator == "*":
+        return left * right
+    if right == 0:
+        raise ZeroDivisionError("division by zero in formula")
+    return left // right
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_rank_users(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    formula = params.get("formula")
+    if not isinstance(formula, str) or len(formula) > _MAX_FORMULA_LENGTH:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid formula"}
+    try:
+        expression = _parse(formula)
+    except _InvalidFormula:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid formula"}
+
+    ranked = []
+    for user in users.list_users():
+        try:
+            score = _evaluate(expression, user["id"], len(user["name"]))
+        except ZeroDivisionError:
+            return 400, {"error": "invalid formula"}
+        ranked.append({"id": user["id"], "name": user["name"], "score": score})
+    ranked.sort(key=lambda entry: (-entry["score"], entry["id"]))
+    return 200, {"users": ranked}
